title: Five independent scaling axes: Loop, Mirror, physical parameters, information, search
intent: Taxonomize tiny-parameter scaling levers before proposing a full attention-equivalent Mirror-Loop architecture; establish where and when each lever earns value, without claiming language-model advantages.

model.mirror_insertion: Rule-indexed Householder reflection -> tanh -> inverse reflection on the shared hidden state. Shared up/down projections; one learnable vector per rule.
model.matched_non_mirror_control: Rule-indexed FiLM-style hidden feature gain with same learned scalar count at matched width; independent tiny per-rule MLP upper/control.
model.loop_model: Fixed 4x4 shared recurrent map plus 4x4 output map, T=1/2/3 sequential residual updates, 32 learned scalars in all variants. A 3-step recurrent teacher provides regression targets.
model.loop_distillation: Compare 1-step direct task learner with 1-step student using a frozen trained 3-step model as auxiliary teacher; record both task loss and extra teacher training compute. Distillation is not assumed to preserve quality.

splits.ood_shift: covariate normal shift x ~ N(0.55, 1.4^2), not new teacher rules
splits.leakage_prevention: Train and dev generated before fitting. Fresh and OOD generated strictly after all checkpoint SHA-256 hashes written. Search and selection use dev only. Synthetic teacher functions are deterministic and frozen.

lanes.representation: Four model types shared-8, FiLM-8, Mirror-8, independent-4, 2 worlds x 3 seeds, identical data and updates. Mirror has 88 trainable scalar coefficients vs FiLM-8 88 vs independent-4 96.
lanes.parameters: FiLM and Mirror widths 4/8/12; 2 worlds x 3 seeds; hold training data/updates fixed.
lanes.data_unique_examples: Mirror and FiLM width8; train sizes 96/384/1536, same 240 updates and batch size, 2 worlds x 3 seeds.
lanes.data_information_quality: Mirror and FiLM width8 on 384 examples with clean balanced / skew 80%-10%-10% / 20% shuffled targets / oracle-filtered 20% noisy labels; same 240 updates; evaluate balanced rule-conditional fresh losses. Oracle filter is an upper control and must not be called an actual curation algorithm.
lanes.loop: Dedicated 3-iteration recurrent teacher, 3 seeds, 32-parameter students with 1/2/3 recurrent steps and 32-parameter one-pass two-layer control; 1-step trained with auxiliary frozen 3-step student via distillation; report both teacher and student training cost.
lanes.search: 2 worlds x 3 seed groups; candidates 1/4/8 total, composed of shared8/film8/mirror8/independent4 repeated with changed initialization; each train 120 steps and dev-select. Compare single FiLM8 model trained 120/480/960 updates. Count all candidate train time/updates and candidate parameter/model size; evaluate fresh only after sealing. Candidate models have 64/88/96 parameters and are not exact-byte matched to each other; selection is exploratory.

decisions.mirror_specific_gate: At width8 and 240 steps Mirror fresh NMSE >=5% better than FiLM in at least 5 of 6 paired world x seed tests; additionally show complete inference bytes and compute; aligned teacher alone is not evidence of general advantage.
decisions.loop_gain_gate: T3 recurrent 32-param student reduces final fresh NMSE >=10% versus T1 on at least 2/3 loop seeds; this is a quality gain, NOT compute efficiency. Separate deployment gate requires distilled T1 final loss <=1.05x learned T3 loss in >=2/3 seeds with <=0.5x active inference MAC proxy.
decisions.data_quality_gate: Oracle-filtered noisy dataset beats unfiltered noisy fresh on >=5/6 paired world x seed for a given architecture; correctly label oracle advantage as a data-quality sanity check, not a real data-cleaning method.
decisions.search_gate: At 4 candidates, dev-selected search fresh NMSE at least 5% better than the single FiLM8 480-update control in >=4/6 pairs; report total actual train time and MAC proxy. A gain only over FiLM8 120-step control is insufficient.
decisions.parameter_scaling: Descriptive Pareto chart; do not predeclare monotonicity or a universal scaling law from 4/8/12 widths.
decisions.data_scaling: Descriptive unique-data frontier, not an asymptotic data-scaling exponent from three points.
decisions.overall_adoption: No architecture-level claim from this tiny synthetic screening, even if one gate passes. A follow-up on natural tokens and attention-equivalent causal semantics is required.

notes: All models below 300 scalar parameters. Count data reuse and search training explicitly; do not call virtual functions independent parameters or equate equal update count with equal FLOPs. Freeze seeds, data, controls, optimizer and gates before training. Preserve failures. No merge to main.
